Welcome to Lofoten Arctic Pearl Lodge (no. 17) in Lofoten! A modern 103 m² lodge where comfort meets the wild beauty of Lofoten. Built to high Scandinavian standards, it features a private sauna, jacuzzi and panoramic ocean views. Set at the end of the road, this is one of the more private lodges in Lyngvær. It offers sweeping 180-degree sea views and quiet seclusion.

Located just 20 minutes from Svolvær and the airport, and 12 minutes from Henningsvær.

The space
This upgraded lodge includes a larger terrace, an EV charger (included) and full floor heating for convenient, year-round stays. The lodge boasts a fully equipped American-style kitchen with top-notch appliances, including an induction cooktop, dishwasher, filter coffee machine, and all the kitchenware you'll need to prepare delicious meals. Enjoy the convenience of a washing machine and dryer, making your stay both comfortable and practical.

Spacious and thoughtfully designed with two bathrooms, both with big showers, it accommodates up to 7 guests and blends modern comfort with the raw beauty of Lofoten. Whether you’re chasing the Northern Lights, exploring fjords, playing a round of golf at Lofoten Links under the midnight sun, or simply unwinding in quiet comfort — this is your base for it all. 

Located just 20 minutes from Svolvær and the airport, and 12 minutes from Henningsvær, it sits close to Lofoten’s finest hiking trails, fishing spots, white-sand beaches, and kayaking routes.

This property is managed by Lyngvær Lodges.

Group trip
This was the most beautiful place I’ve ever stayed at. If you are going to travel in three flights to get somewhere you want it to be perfect and this house was truly it. It has three comfortable bedrooms and two separate bathrooms so our party of six had room to relax. The sauna and hot tub were great after a day of hiking. The kitchen had everything we needed to cook breakfasts and dinners. Beds were comfortable. Everything was great. And the highlight was the view. You honestly cannot take your eyes away from those huge windows and the long twilight. If I had a dollar for every time I said ‘ this is gorgeous’ it would have paid for the trip:-)
I also want to mention how friendly and helpful Oliver was. Lots of info ahead of time (Eg what shops are open on Sunday) He also arranged a personal chef one evening which was an exceptional treat. The food showcased local produce and ingredients and was a true foodie experience. If you have an event to celebrate do consider this.
